source_prompts.fragment: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the approved, extremely simple fictional RimExodus Delta-V rail slug into one single broken-off metal shard. Use the same plain matte medium gray and dark gray side planes, and a small light-gray area on its fractured face. Replace the long rod with a short irregular sliver, about 2.4 times taller than wide, with a short slanting irregular break at the wider bottom and a slightly off-center chipped point at the top. It must look like a torn piece of the same solid material. Large flat areas, just three values, detail density of a traditional low-resolution top-down projectile. The shard points vertically up, centered on the canvas. Exactly one connected object and real transparent alpha background. No cast shadow, glow, trail, blurry edges, ambient rays, tiny chips, grain, gradients, faceted gemstone look, texture, label, outlines inside the part or other elements. Use the same single dark side plane and restrained grayscale as the reference.
source_prompts.propellant: Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone original inventory sprite for the RimExodus Delta-V colony-sim mod, a fictional ship propellant supply canister. Strict orthographic top-down, diagonal alignment with the sealed end at upper right, center of object at canvas center. A short, stubby parallel-sided industrial cylinder silhouette with two flat ends, about 1.6 times as long as wide. Its broad dark slate-gray body has a muted amber end cap, broad enough to read at 32 pixels. One neutral-gray broad highlight block, broad darker underside, clear dark charcoal outline. Three or four hand-painted matte color masses, shape and color visible at 32 pixels. Restrained, utilitarian, very simple silhouette with thickness. One isolated object on true transparency, substantial safe padding, no surface or background, shadow, smoke, markings, labels, fine details, weathering, reflective metal, tiny highlights, gradients, seams, screws, cartridges beside it, or decorative stripes.
source_prompts.steel: Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone, original flat raster inventory sprite for the RimExodus Delta-V colony-sim mod, a fictional high-explosive steel projectile head as a supply object. Orthographic top-down, diagonal alignment with nose at upper right. Broad thick shoulder and a short bluntly tapered rounded nose, flat squared base, about 1.8 times as long as wide. Silvery medium-gray main body with a single warm worn yellow band at its shoulder. One pale gray top plane and one darker gray side plane, clear dark charcoal outline. Large matte color areas, muted utilitarian palette, very simplified top-down tabletop strategy sprite; clear at 32 pixels. The broad short projectile head should look like one component, with no cartridge case. Center one object on true transparent background with comfortable padding. No cast shadow, glow, thin detail, surface texture, fine seams, metallic glints, rivets, gradient, markings, text, accessories or extra objects.
source_prompts.uranium: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a very simple original 2D inventory icon for a fictional colony management computer game: one olive-gray angular metal wedge. The silhouette is a long, narrow, asymmetric solid geometric industrial part with a triangular point at the upper right and a flat cut lower-left end. Diagonal northeast axis, seen in orthographic top-down view. It has one matte graphite face, one muted olive-gray side, and a short solid light gray plane at the point. The general look is an uncomplicated hand-painted inventory sprite for a tabletop-like strategy game, three broad flat tones, approximately 3:1 long to wide, clearly readable when converted to a 32-pixel icon. Center a single object with safe margins on genuine alpha transparency. Simple charcoal perimeter. No lettering, realistic details, gradients, highlights, surface texture, shadow, logo, floor, background or extra objects.
source_prompts.slug: Simplify the attached fictional space-game railgun slug into a very low-detail, flat 2D in-flight sprite for a colony simulator. Preserve the original long slender solid rod outer silhouette, the arrow-up orientation, flat square tail, and central placement. The visual language must be drastically simpler than the reference, like a hand-drawn 64-pixel-era top-down projectile that will be displayed only a few pixels wide. Only three large flat matte colors: a single short light-gray solid nose shape, a uniform medium gray body occupying nearly the entire rod, and one subdued narrow darker gray side strip. The nose is one unbroken color shape, not a diamond with facets. Keep the silhouette naturally legible on black space. Completely remove the current hairline bevel streak, shiny metal reflections, multiple pointed facets, paint grain, heavy outline and diffuse halos. Hard clean silhouette with modest anti-aliasing only, no photorealistic or 3D metal rendering, zero gradients, no shadow, no trailing or glowing pixels, no frames, no labels, no extra features. Single isolated sprite on real alpha transparency; do not add a background, dark rectangle, vignette, floor, checkerboard or atmospheric light. Preserve the very elongated height-to-width ratio of the supplied shape. The object moves upward, with the nose at the top.

upright_projectile_heads.preparation: Align to the lower body centerline, mirror the selected half and center the result on a 128-pixel canvas. Overlap copies without rotation for the two stacks.

source_prompts.steel: Redesign this fictional colony-sim inventory icon so it stands exactly upright. Draw one very simple short broad solid metal game token, appearing head-on in orthographic top-down view, with a centered rounded nose pointing straight up, mirror-symmetric rounded shoulders, parallel straight sides, and a single flat horizontal bottom. Nose midpoint, body and base midpoint exactly share the center of the canvas. The silhouette is short and visibly stubby. Use the same plain silver-gray matte colors, charcoal contour and prominent mustard yellow horizontal band spanning the full width near the lower middle. Two large flat gray tone faces can distinguish light and shade. Use broad, clean flat shapes with the low detail density of a 2D inventory sprite that will read at 32 pixels. Zero oblique view or depth offset, no elliptic end cap, no tail fins, no protrusions, texture, lettering, cast shadow, effects, glow or ground. Only one centered original fictional geometric game asset on real transparent alpha.
source_prompts.uranium: Redesign this abstract olive gray metal inventory token for a fictional colony strategy game as an upright and perfectly left-right symmetric geometric sprite. Strict orthographic view straight above. One narrow straight-sided gray solid with a long, slender triangular top pointing exactly upward and a flat horizontal bottom. Both faces meet at a centered apex. Both sides curve or taper by the same amount and reach their widest points at the same height. Use the original matte olive gray and graphite palette, a lighter tip made of a broad flat gray shape, and a crisp charcoal outer edge. A broad side tone for emphasis is fine as long as the silhouette remains mirror-symmetric. Make this a distinct simple shape, clearly taller and narrower than a typical game inventory icon. No angled pose, no perspective showing thickness behind the baseline, no step, protrusion, fins, offset, markings, text, halo, shadow or extra object. Only an isolated original geometric game icon centered on real transparent alpha. Clean enough to read at 32px.

diagonal_projectile_heads.source: The two centered, symmetric single-item sprites documented under upright_projectile_heads.
diagonal_projectile_heads.preparation: Rotate each sprite as a whole 45 degrees clockwise and center it along the new longitudinal axis. Enforce exact mirror symmetry across the canvas anti-diagonal. Compose the two stacks by translating copies of the same rotated single sprite.
